selected_skill.selection_reason: High-star sales-marketing skill that maps directly to assembling a fundraising fact set, then generating a memo, one-pager, financial model, and use-of-funds table with aligned numbers.

safe_use_screening.notes: Excluded skills that depend on LinkedIn, X, outbound email systems, CRM workspaces, or user-level private analytics.

real_data_design.source_type: public metro housing snapshots plus local company inputs
real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Public metro-level housing metrics are copied into a local CSV, while company pricing, traction, milestones, and model assumptions live in local structured notes. Older drafts carry conflicting values to create reconciliation pressure without changing the core public-source facts.
real_data_design.determinism: All source-derived values are stored in task inputs so the verifier can recompute the expected outputs without network calls.

environment_design.with_without_control: The runtime pair differs only by whether environment/skills is present in the build context. Dockerfile copies skills into Codex skill directories when the folder exists.

goals: Keep the prompt centered on deliverables, constraints, and output contracts.
State that older draft materials may conflict with current inputs without revealing the full reconciliation workflow.
Require a base-case 8-quarter model and aligned deliverables without explaining the exact skill method.
hidden_workflow_pressure: The base-case assumptions file includes multiple scenarios, so the solver must choose the approved one.
Older materials contain stale round terms, pricing, revenue, and market scope values that can leak into prose outputs.
The verifier checks for cross-document consistency and outdated-value contamination.

main_tests: required output files exist and parse
fundraising facts match the current round, pricing, traction, market metrics, and milestone plan
financial model exactly matches the approved base-case rollforward and revenue rules
use-of-funds rows and shares match policy
reconciliation log covers every draft conflict and the approved milestone/model tension
memo and one-pager include the required sections and current key facts
guardrails: outputs do not carry stale round terms, stale pricing, or stale metro scope values from older drafts
without-skill misses should come from incomplete reconciliation or missed input tension handling, not from cosmetic formatting
all verifier tests run to completion
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should be action-level misses such as incomplete stale-value reconciliation, missing the current milestone-versus-model tension, mixing the stretch scenario into the model, or leaving memo and one-pager out of sync with the fact set.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial starts from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and comparison trials are complete.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence in the runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.verifier_review_note: Final comparison statistics are reviewed under the current verifier semantics. The only relaxed point is that reconciliation-log row order and accepted equivalent machine-value variants do not affect pass/fail; content mismatches still fail.
